items.name: Adaspace (6935)

note.de: Satellitenbauer aus Chengdu; 30,12 Mio. Aktien zu 24,90 HKD am unteren Ende der Spanne (750 Mio. HKD). Erster Kurs 24,44 HKD (−1,8 %), zuletzt 24,60 HKD laut Reuters.
note.bg: Производител на сателити от Чънду; 30,12 млн. акции по 24,90 HKD в долния край на диапазона (750 млн. HKD). Първа цена 24,44 HKD (−1,8%), след това 24,60 HKD според Reuters.
note.en: Chengdu satellite maker; 30.12m shares at HKD 24.90, the bottom of the range (HKD 750m). Opened at HKD 24.44 (−1.8%), last at HKD 24.60 according to Reuters.
note.es: Fabricante de satélites de Chengdu; 30,12 millones de acciones a 24,90 HKD, en el extremo inferior del rango (750 millones de HKD). Abrió a 24,44 HKD (−1,8 %) y cotizó luego a 24,60 HKD, según Reuters.
note.tr: Chengdu merkezli uydu üreticisi; aralığın alt ucundan 24,90 HKD'den 30,12 milyon hisse (750 milyon HKD). Reuters'a göre ilk fiyat 24,44 HKD (−%1,8), son 24,60 HKD.

items.name: vVardis (VVVV)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 18 USD – unter der Spanne von 21–24 USD; 9,72 Mio. Aktien (ca. 175 Mio. USD). Handelsstart heute an der NYSE, ein erster Kurs lag bei Redaktionsschluss noch nicht vor.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 18 USD – под диапазона 21–24 USD; 9,72 млн. акции (около 175 млн. USD). Търговията на NYSE започва днес; към момента на публикуване първа цена още няма.
note.en: Priced at USD 18, below the USD 21–24 range; 9.72m shares (about USD 175m). Trading on the NYSE starts today; no first trade had been reported at the time of writing.
note.es: Precio de salida de 18 USD, por debajo del rango de 21–24 USD; 9,72 millones de acciones (unos 175 millones de USD). Empieza a cotizar hoy en la NYSE; al cierre de esta edición no había primer precio.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 18 USD – 21–24 USD aralığının altında; 9,72 milyon hisse (yaklaşık 175 milyon USD). NYSE'de işlemler bugün başlıyor; yayın saatinde henüz ilk fiyat yoktu.

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 17 USD (Mitte der Spanne) für 10,29 Mio. Aktien; mit der Sanofi-Privatplatzierung über 50 Mio. USD fließen brutto rund 225 Mio. USD. Handelsstart heute an der Nasdaq.
note.bg: Цена 17 USD (средата на диапазона) за 10,29 млн. акции; заедно с частното пласиране на Sanofi за 50 млн. USD брутният приход е около 225 млн. USD. Търговията на Nasdaq започва днес.
note.en: Priced at USD 17 (mid-range) for 10.29m shares; with Sanofi's USD 50m private placement, gross proceeds total about USD 225m. Trading on Nasdaq starts today.
note.es: Precio de 17 USD (mitad del rango) por 10,29 millones de acciones; con la colocación privada de 50 millones de Sanofi, los ingresos brutos rondan los 225 millones de USD. Cotiza desde hoy en el Nasdaq.
note.tr: 10,29 milyon hisse için 17 USD fiyat (aralığın ortası); Sanofi'nin 50 milyon USD'lik özel yerleşimiyle brüt gelir yaklaşık 225 milyon USD. Nasdaq'ta işlemler bugün başlıyor.

items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: 825 Mio. Aktien zu 70–78 USD (bis 64,4 Mrd. USD); laut Bloomberg rund sechsfach überzeichnet. Preisfestsetzung laut CNBC am 18.11. erwartet, Handelsstart am 19.11.
note.bg: 825 млн. акции по 70–78 USD (до 64,4 млрд. USD); според Bloomberg записването е около шест пъти над предлагането. Според CNBC цената се очаква на 18.11., търговията – на 19.11.
note.en: 825m shares at USD 70–78 (up to USD 64.4bn); about six times oversubscribed according to Bloomberg. Pricing expected on 18 Nov according to CNBC, trading on 19 Nov.
note.es: 825 millones de acciones a 70–78 USD (hasta 64.400 millones de USD); según Bloomberg, la demanda sextuplica la oferta. Según CNBC, precio previsto el 18/11 y debut el 19/11.
note.tr: 70–78 USD'den 825 milyon hisse (64,4 milyar USD'ye kadar); Bloomberg'e göre yaklaşık altı kat fazla talep. CNBC'ye göre fiyatın 18.11'de, işlemlerin 19.11'de başlaması bekleniyor.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – American Barrick Gold files for an estimated $6 billion IPO (10.11.2026); The Deep Dive (11.11.2026: Start bis Anfang 2027 laut CEO Mark Hill)
